items.text: Chelili chipúpu chinahiti dehi, Yehova hakuhosha naMosina Eleyazari mwana kakapristu Aroni,
nindi, Chindenu chipompelu chawanyana kaIsarela chejima, kufumishila hadi anyaka makumi ayedi nakutwala kumbidi, mwahita mavumu awankakulula jawu, amuIsarela ejima ayilaŋa kunjita.
AMosi nakapristu Eleyazari ahosheli nawu muyanaya kuMowabi kuYodana kuYeriku,
nawu, Chindenu antu, mufumishilihadi anyaka makumi ayedi nakutwala kumbidi, mwalejeliyi Yehova Mosinianyana kaIsarela afumini mwituŋa daEjipitu.
Rubeni, wedi waIsarela. Anyana kaRubeni amayala; aHanoki, chisaka chawaHanoki; aPalu, chisaka chawaPalu;
aHezeroni, chisaka chawaHezeroni; aKarami, chisaka chawaKarami.
Yeniyi diyi yisakaya waRubeni. Achindiluwu ashikili mumakombakaji makumi awananasatu namakulakaji atanu nayedi namakumi asatu.
Anyana kaPalu amayala; Eliyabi.
Anyana kaEliyabi amayala; Nemuweli, niDatani naAbirami. Wenawa diwu aDatani naAbirami atambikiluwu muchipompelu alwili naMosi naAroni hamu nawapompeli naKora, halwiluwuna Yehova.
Iseki hidikuyasamina kanwa kadu, hidikuyiminyina hamu naKora, hafwiluwu antu apompeli; hanoŋesheli kesi amayala makulakaji ayedi namakumi atanu hiyakwikala chinjikijilu.
Hela chochu, anyana kaKora hiyafwiluku.
Anyana kaSimeyona amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aNemweli, chisaka chawaNemweli; aYamini, chisaka chawaYamini; aYakini, chisaka chawaYakini;
aZera, chisaka chawaZera; aShawulu, chisaka chawaShawulu.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yawaSimeyona, makombakaji makumi ayedi nayedi, namakulakaji ayedi.
Anyana kaGadi amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aZefwoni, chisaka chawaZefwoni; aHagi, chisaka chawaHaŋi; aShuni, chisaka chawaShuni;
aOzini, chisaka chawaOzini; aEri, chisaka chawaEri;
aArodi, chisaka chawaArodi; aAreli, chisaka chawaAreli.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yawanyana kaGadi, mwomwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi awana namakulakaji atanu.
Anyana kaYuda amayala; Eri naOnani; niEri niOnani afwilili mwituŋa daKenani.
Tiya mwahita yisaka yawanyana kaYuda amayala; aShela, chisaka chawaShela; aPerezi, chisaka chawaPerezi; aZera, chisaka chawaZera.
Tiya anyana kaPerezi amayala; aHezeroni, chisaka chawaHezeroni; aHamuli, chisaka chawaHamuli.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yaYuda mwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi atanu nayedi namakombakaji atanu nadimu, namakulakaji atanu.
Anyana kaIsakari amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aTola, chisaka chawaTola; aPuva, chisaka chawaPuva;
aYashubi, chisaka chawaYashubi; AShimironi, chisaka chawaShimironi.
Yeniyi diyi yisakaya Isakari mwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi atanu nadimu namakombakaji awana, namakulakaji asatu.
Anyana kaZebuluni amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aSeredi, chisaka chawaSeredi; aEloni, chisaka chawaEloni; aYahaleyeli, chisaka chawaYahaleyeli.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yawaZebuluni mwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi atanu nadimu, namakulakaji atanu.
Anyana kaYosefu amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; Manase naEfweremi.
Anyana kaManase amayala; aMakiri, chisaka chawaMakiri; Makiri wavweli Gileyadi; aGileyadi, chisaka chawaGileyadi.
Tiya anyana kaGileyadi amayala; aYezeri, chisaka chawaYezeri; aHeleki, chisaka chawaHeleki;
aAsariyeli, chisaka chawaAsariyeli; aShekemi, chisaka chawaShekemi;
aShemida, chisaka chawaShemida; aHefwenai, chisaka chawaHefwenai.
Zelofwehadi mwana kaHefwenai hadiŋi nawanyana amayalaku, chiŋa awambanda hohu; anyana kaZelofwehadi awambanda majinawu iwu Mahala, iwu Nowa, iwu Hoŋala, iwu Milika, iwu Tiriza.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yaManase; achindiluwu ashikili mumakombakaji makumi atanu namakombakaji ayedi, namakulakaji atanu nayedi.
Tiya anyana kaEfweremi amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aShutela, chisaka chawaShutela; aBekeri, chisaka chawaBekeri; aTahani, chisaka chawaTahani.
Tiya anyana kaShutela amayala; aErani, chisaka chawaErani.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yawanyana kaEfweremi amayala mwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi asatu nayedi, namakulakaji atanu. Wenawa diwu anyana kaYosefu amayala mwahita yisaka yawu.
Anyana kaBenjamini amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aBela, chisaka chawaBela; aAshabeli, chisaka chawaAshabeli; aAhirami, chisaka chawaAhirami;
aShufwami, chisaka chawaShufwami; aHufwami, chisaka chawaHufwami.
Anyana kaBela adiŋi Aradi naNayamani; aAradi, chisaka chawaAradi; aNayamani, chisaka chawaNayamani.
Wenawadiwu anyana kaBenjamini amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; achindiluwu ashikili mumakombakaji makumi awana natanu, namakulakaji atanu nadimu.
Tiya anyana kaDani amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aShuhami, chisaka chawaShuhami. Yeniyi diyi yisaka yaDani mwahita yisaka yawu.
Yisakaya waShuhami yejima mwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi atanu nadimu namakombakaji awana, namakulakaji awana.
Anyana kaAsheŋa mayala mwahita yisaka yawu; amina, chisaka chawaImina; aIshivi, chisaka chawaIshivi; aBeriya, chisaka chawaBeriya.
Ahadi anyana kaBeriya amayala; aHeberi, chisaka chawaHeberi; aMalakiyeli, chisaka chawaMalakiyeli.
Mwana kaAsheri wamumbanda ijina dindi Sera.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yawanyana kaAsheri amayala mwashikili achindiluwu, makombakaji makumi atanu namakombakaji asatu, namakulakaji awana.
Anyana kaNafwatali amayala mwahita yisaka yawu; aYahazeyeli, chisaka chawaYahazeyeli; aGuni, chisaka chawaGuni;
aYezeri, chisaka chawaYezeri; aShilemi, chisaka chawaShilemi.
Yeniyi diyi yisaka yaNafwatali mwahita yisaka yawu; achindiluwu ashikili mumakombakaji makumi awana namakombakaji atanu, namakulakaji awana.
Wenawa diwu achindiluwu hadi anyana kaIsarela, makombakaji makulakaji atanu nadimu nekombakaji dimu, namakulakaji atanu nayedina makumi asatu.
Yehova wahosheli naMosi,
nindi, Wenawa diwu waka anjaŋena ituŋidiikali wuswana wawu mwomwachindilawu majina.
Amavulu wakayinkiwuswana wawuvulu, antesha wakayinki wuswana wantesha, iwu akamwinka mwomwachindililuwu antu indi, chochu hohu wejima wawu.
Helachochu ituŋa akadanjanaŋa nachinjikijilu chakusakula nachu; mwomwashikila majina anyichidi yawankakulula jawu dimu mwakaswaninawu.
Mwakasakwilawu chinjikijilu mwomwaka anjaŋenawu wuswana wawu, hela amavulu, hela antesha.
Tiya aLevi achindiluwu mwahita yisaka yawu; aGereshoni, chisaka chawaGereshoni; aKohati, chisaka chawaKohati; aMerari, chisaka chawaMerari.
Tiya yisaka yawaLevi; chisaka chawaLibini, chisaka chawa-Heberoni, chisaka chawaMahali, chisaka chawaMushi, chisaka chawaKora. Kohati wavweli Amarama.
Iŋoda Amarama, ijina dindi Yokebedi mwanakaLevi, amuvweleleluwu Levi muEjipitu; yena wamuvweleleli Amarama anyana, aAroni, naMosi, namuhelawu Miriyami.
Aroni amuvweleleli Nadabi naAbihu, Eliyazari naItamari.
Nadabi naAbihu afwili halambwilu wukesi kacheŋi kumesu aYehova.

Achindiluwu ashikili mumakombakaji makumi ayedi namakombakaji asatu, wowu amayala ejima akufumishilaha kakweji kamu nakutwala kumbidi. Muloŋa wena hiyayichindili hamuna wanyana kaIsarelaku, muloŋa wena hiyayinkeli wuswana hamu nawanyana kaIsarelaku.
Wenawa diwu achindiluwu kudi aMosi nakapristu Eleyazari; wowu achindili anyana kaIsarela muyana yakuMowabi kuYodana kuYeriku.
Ilaŋa hadi wenawa hihadiŋi hela wumu achindiluwu kudi aMosi nakapristu Aroni, achindili anyana kaIsarela mwisaŋada kuSinayuku.
Muloŋa Yehova wayilili nindi, Chiŋa afwila mwisaŋa hohu. Hihasheli hoku iyalaniwumuku, chiŋa yowu mwana kaYefune Kalebi, ni mwana kaNuni Yoshuwa.
